entries.title: I Corinthians 15:1
segments: And, brothers, I declare to you the gospel which I preached to you, which also you have received, and in which you stand;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:2
segments: by which you also are being kept safe, if you hold fast the word which I preached to you, unless you believed in vain.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:3
segments: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received, that Christ died for our sins, according to the Scriptures,

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:4
segments: and that He was buried, and that He rose again the third day according to the Scriptures;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:5
segments: and that He was seen by Cephas, then by the Twelve.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:6
segments: Afterward He was seen by over five hundred brothers at once, of whom the greater part remain until this present day, but also some fell asleep.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:7
segments: Afterward He was seen by James, then by all the apostles.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:8
segments: And last of all He was seen by me also, as one born out of time.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:9
segments: For I am the least of the apostles and am not sufficient to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:10
segments: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace which [was] toward me has not been without fruit, but I labored more abundantly than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God with me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:11
segments: Therefore whether [it was] I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:12
segments: But if Christ is proclaimed, that He was raised from [the] dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:13
segments: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:14
segments: And if Christ has not been raised, then our proclamation [is] worthless, and your faith [is] also worthless.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:15
segments: And we are also found [to be] false witnesses of God, because we testified of God that He raised Christ; whom He did not raise if the dead are not raised.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:16
segments: For if [the] dead are not raised, then Christ is not raised.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:17
segments: And if Christ is not raised, your faith [is] foolish; you are yet in your sins.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:18
segments: Then also those that fell asleep in Christ were lost.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:19
segments: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:20
segments: But now Christ has risen from [the] dead, [and] has become the firstfruit of those who slept.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:21
segments: For since death [is] through man, the resurrection of [the] dead also [is] through a Man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:22
segments: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ all will be made alive.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:23
segments: But each in [his] own order: Christ the first-fruit, and afterward they who are Christ's at His coming;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:24
segments: then [is] the end, when He delivers the kingdom to God, even the Father; when He makes to cease all rule and all authority and power.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:25
segments: for it is right for Him to reign until He has put all the enemies under His feet.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:26
segments: The last enemy made to cease [is] death.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:27
segments: For He put all things under His feet. But when He says that all things have been put under [His feet], it is plain that [it] excepts Him who has put all things under Him.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:28
segments: But when all things are subjected to Him, then the Son Himself also will be subject to Him who has subjected things to Him, so that God may be all things in all.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:29
segments: Otherwise, what will they do, those being baptized on behalf of [the] dead? If the dead are not at all raised, why indeed are they baptized on behalf of [the] dead?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:30
segments: And why are we also in danger every hour?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:31
segments: Day by day I die, by your rejoicing, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:32
segments: If according to man I fought with beasts in Ephesus, what advantage is to me if [the] dead are not raised? "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!"

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:33
segments: Do not be deceived, evil companionships corrupt good habits.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:34
segments: Be righteously awake, and sin not; for some have ignorance of God. I speak [this] to your shame.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:35
segments: But someone will say, How are the dead raised up, and with what body do they come?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:36
segments: Foolish one! What you sow is not made alive unless it dies.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:37
segments: And what you sow, you do not sow the body that [is] going to be, but a bare grain (perhaps of wheat or of some of the rest).

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:38
segments: And God gives it a body as it has pleased Him, and to each of the seeds its own body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:39
segments: All flesh [is] not the same flesh; but one [kind of] flesh of men, and another flesh of beasts, and another of fish, and another of birds.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:40
segments: [There are] also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the glory of the heavenly [is] truly different, and that of the earthly different;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:41
segments: one glory of [the] sun, and another glory of [the] moon, and another glory of [the] stars; for [one] star differs from [another] star in glory.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:42
segments: So also the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption, it is raised in incorruption;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:43
segments: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:44
segments: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:45
segments: And so it is written, "The first man, Adam, [was made] a living soul," the last Adam was a life-giving Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:46
segments: But not the spiritual first, but the natural; afterward the spiritual.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:47
segments: The first man [was] out of earth, earthy; the second Man [was] the Lord from Heaven.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:48
segments: Such the earthy [man], such also the earthy ones. And such the heavenly [Man], such also the heavenly ones.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:49
segments: And according as we bore the image of the earthy [man], we shall also bear the image of the heavenly [Man].

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:50
segments: And I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit [the] kingdom of God, nor does corruption inherit incorruption.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:51
segments: Behold, I speak a mystery to you; we shall not all fall asleep, but we shall all be changed;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:52
segments: in a moment, in a glance of an eye, at the last trumpet. For a trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall all be changed.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:53
segments: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal [must] put on immortality.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:54
segments: But when this corruptible shall put on incorruption, and when this mortal shall put on immortality, then will take place the word that is written, "Death is swallowed up in victory.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:55
segments: O death, where [is] your sting? O grave, where [is] your victory?"

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:56
segments: The sting of death [is] sin, and the strength of sin [is] the law.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:57
segments: But thanks [be] to God who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:58
segments: So that, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not without fruit in the Lord.
